newsitem.title: USA: Stock market romps to yet another record high.
newsitem.headline: Stock market romps to yet another record high.

text.p: Stocks romped to record highs for the second session in a row Tuesday, lifting the Dow Jones industrial average within a few points of a new milestone of 7,400 points following a powerful rally in technology shares.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 37.50 points at 7,383.41, beating Friday's record finish of 7,345.91. The market was closed Monday for Memorial Day.

The Nasdaq Composite index also set a second consecutive high, closing up 19.48 points at 1,409.20. But in the broader market, declining issues outnumbered advances by a thin margin on active volume of 439 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
